caption: The drawing features a decorative container with an ornate handle and base. The container is predominantly light blue and has a scalloped rim at the top. The handle, base, and accents along the sides resemble twisting branches or vines and are colored in shades of brown and gold. Attached to these branch-like elements are several light green leaves and white flowers with yellow centers, which are distributed around the bowl’s surface. The composition is centered on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or details present.
title: Ornamental Basket
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
